The business need

Start with what’s getting in the way.

Technology should support the work your organization needs to do. A focused conversation establishes priorities before options are proposed.

Common starting points

Frequently asked questions

Before we get started.

Can you work with our existing equipment?

Yes. An engagement can start with a review of your current environment and compatibility needs before any replacement is proposed.

Do you supply equipment as well as install it?

Technology sourcing and integration can be scoped together. Availability, licensing and procurement terms are confirmed for each enquiry.

Do you offer ongoing support?

Support can be discussed and documented as part of a proposal. Coverage depends on the agreed scope.
